visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female celebrity, Jennie, is shown in a medium shot against a dense background of pale yellow flowers. She wears a black off-the-shoulder dress decorated with multiple pearl necklaces and a central white camellia. She smiles warmly with her head tilted, sporting a black and white hat. (2) The scene cuts to a high-angle close-up of a desk environment. A pair of hands with long, neutral-toned nails uses large metallic scissors to cut a rectangular piece of heavy black satin fabric. A computer mouse and dark monitor stand are visible in the background. (3) The hands guide the black fabric through a white sewing machine, stitching the edges carefully. This is followed by a shot using a pink hand-held press tool to clamp black snap fasteners onto the fabric. The lighting is bright and even across the workspace. (4) A black branded box is opened, revealing a white ribbon and a large artificial white camellia flower. The hands then use a needle and thread to sew the flower onto a small, finished black dress displayed on a miniature dress form. (5) A young girl with short dark hair appears, wearing the completed miniature dress and a matching black and white hat. She stands in a carpeted indoor lounge with a modern sofa and large floor-to-ceiling windows showing a night city view. (6) The girl walks around the room with high energy, posing for the camera by putting her fingers to her lips and touching her cheeks. She laughs and adjusts her hat, while yellow and white text overlays appear at the bottom of the screen.

The rhythmic whirring of a sewing machine motor follows, adding a mechanical layer to the mid-frequency range. The narrator's tone shifts to a slightly more strained pitch while describing the thick material. (4) A crisp rustling of paper and silk ribbons occurs as a box is opened. A sudden 'Whoosh' transition leads into a recognizable K-pop track ('Solo') featuring heavy bass and sharp synthesized percussion. (5) The K-pop music increases in volume. The faint, high-frequency sound of a child's laughter is audible briefly. The narration concludes with a warm and inviting tone as the music fades slightly.
